rules.message: Google Cloud VPC or subnet has an invalid or missing CIDR
rules.recommendation: Enter a valid IPv4 CIDR and confirm that it matches the intended Google Cloud address plan.

rules.message: Google Cloud subnet falls outside its parent network
rules.recommendation: Move the subnet into the parent Google Cloud VPC address range or correct the network CIDR.

rules.message: Google Cloud network ranges overlap or duplicate one another
rules.recommendation: Assign unique, non-overlapping CIDRs within the same network boundary.

rules.message: Google Cloud subnet has incomplete routing facts
rules.recommendation: Set the subnet classification and route table so exposure and routing can be reviewed.

rules.message: Google Cloud internet path has no modeled security boundary
rules.recommendation: Add Google Cloud WAF or another security boundary to the ingress path, or document the equivalent managed control.

rules.message: Google Cloud database is placed in a public subnet
rules.recommendation: Move the database to a private data subnet and permit only required application traffic.

rules.message: VPC Flow Logs is not modeled
rules.recommendation: Add VPC Flow Logs and identify its destination, retention, and review owner.

rules.message: Google Cloud critical workloads use fewer than two zones
rules.recommendation: Place critical compute and data services in at least two independent failure domains.

rules.message: Google Cloud critical database has no standby or redundancy fact
rules.recommendation: Add a standby or replica in another failure domain and model the replication relationship.

rules.message: Google Cloud database replication is incomplete
rules.recommendation: Connect primary and standby databases with a typed replication relationship.

rules.message: A single Cloud NAT serves multiple zones
rules.recommendation: Add a Cloud NAT per active zone and route private subnets to their local gateway.

rules.message: Google Cloud firewall is a single point of failure
rules.recommendation: Model an active/standby or scale-out security boundary across failure domains.

rules.message: Google Cloud asset has no modeled relationship
rules.recommendation: Connect the asset to its dependency or remove it from the architecture.

rules.message: Google Cloud critical asset has no monitoring definition
rules.recommendation: Record health, performance, log, alert, and escalation coverage for the asset.

rules.message: Google Cloud critical stateful asset has no backup definition
rules.recommendation: Document backup scope, retention, restore target, testing frequency, and ownership.

rules.message: Google Cloud network relationship has no purpose label
rules.recommendation: Name the protocol, carrier, trust boundary, or traffic purpose.
